strings.oobe_features_subtitle: Crafted for a hi-res listening experience
strings.oobe_features_swipe_hint: Swipe or tap cards to explore all features
strings.oobe_feat_spatial_desc: Depth-layered artwork with gyroscope parallax brings album covers to life with fluid light and motion.
strings.oobe_feat_sing_desc: Real-time on-device vocal and instrumental separation with zero cloud upload — adjust vocal volume anytime to sing along.
strings.oobe_feat_lyrics_desc: Fluid syllable-by-syllable lyric highlights paired with LLM-powered translation that preserves nuance and context.
strings.oobe_feat_dsp_desc: Precision parametric EQ, curated sound presets, and bit-perfect USB DAC exclusive output unlock lossless master detail.
strings.oobe_feat_library_desc: Seamlessly combines local lossless files with NetEase and QQ Music cloud playlists, or switches to pure local mode in one tap.
strings.oobe_optional_login_summary: Optional, tap to sign in directly
strings.oobe_feat_ui_desc: Switch freely between Hyper, Material, and One UI styles with liquid-glass navigation bars and dynamic theming.
strings.oobe_feat_widget_desc: Multi-size interactive home screen widgets paired with immersive rear-screen controls for effortless playback.
strings.oobe_feat_share_desc: Generate minimalist lyric cards from built-in templates and edit lossless audio metadata and cover art locally.
